023        public static int OFFICER_SKILL_CHOICES_BASE = Global.getSettings().getInt("officerSkillChoicesBase");
024        public static int OFFICER_SKILL_CHOICES_MENTORED = Global.getSettings().getInt("officerSkillChoicesMentored");
025        
026        //public static float XP_MULT = 5f;
027        public static float XP_MULT = Global.getSettings().getFloat("officerXPRequiredMult");
028        
029        public static float EXPONENT_BEYOND_MAX_SPECIFIED_LEVEL = 1.1f;
030        
031        public static long [] XP_PER_LEVEL = new long [] {
032                0,              // level 1
033                12000,
034                20000,
035                35000,
036                45000,  // level 5
037                50000,
038                50000,
039                50000,
040                50000,
041                50000,
042        };
043        
044        public static long [] TOTAL_XP_PER_LEVEL = new long [XP_PER_LEVEL.length];
045        
046        static {
047                long total = 0;
048                for (int i = 0; i < XP_PER_LEVEL.length; i++) {
049                        total += XP_PER_LEVEL[i];
050                        TOTAL_XP_PER_LEVEL[i] = total;
051                }
052        }
053        
054        public long getXPForLevel(int level) {
055                if (level <= 1) return 0;
056                
057                if (level - 1 < TOTAL_XP_PER_LEVEL.length) {
058                        return (long) (TOTAL_XP_PER_LEVEL[level - 1] * XP_MULT);
059                }
060                
061                int maxSpecified = TOTAL_XP_PER_LEVEL.length;
062                long curr = TOTAL_XP_PER_LEVEL[maxSpecified - 1];
063                long last = XP_PER_LEVEL[maxSpecified - 1];
064                for (int i = maxSpecified; i < level; i++) {
065                        last *= EXPONENT_BEYOND_MAX_SPECIFIED_LEVEL;
066                        curr += last;
067                }
068
069                return (long) (curr * XP_MULT);
070        }
071        
072        public static void main(String[] args) {
073                for (int i = 1; i <= 6; i++) {
074                        System.out.println("Level " + i + ": " + new OfficerLevelupPluginImpl().getXPForLevel(i));
075                }
076        }

078        public int getMaxLevel(PersonAPI person) {
079                if (person != null && person.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().contains(MemFlags.OFFICER_MAX_LEVEL)) {
080                        return person.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().getInt(MemFlags.OFFICER_MAX_LEVEL);
081                }
082                int bonus = 0;
083                if (person != null) {
084                        MutableCharacterStatsAPI stats = person.getFleetCommanderStats();
085                        if (stats != null) {
086                                bonus = (int) stats.getDynamic().getMod(Stats.OFFICER_MAX_LEVEL_MOD).computeEffective(0);
087                        }
088                }
089                return (int) Global.getSettings().getFloat("officerMaxLevel") + bonus;
090        }
091        
092        public int getMaxEliteSkills(PersonAPI person) {
093                if (person != null && person.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().contains(MemFlags.OFFICER_MAX_ELITE_SKILLS)) {
094                        return person.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().getInt(MemFlags.OFFICER_MAX_ELITE_SKILLS);
095                }
096                int bonus = 0;
097                if (person != null) {
098                        MutableCharacterStatsAPI stats = person.getFleetCommanderStats();
099                        if (stats != null) {
100                                bonus = (int) stats.getDynamic().getMod(Stats.OFFICER_MAX_ELITE_SKILLS_MOD).computeEffective(0);
101                        }
102                }
103                return (int) Global.getSettings().getFloat("officerMaxEliteSkills") + bonus;
104        }

106        public List<String> pickLevelupSkillsV2(PersonAPI person, Random random) {
107                if (random == null) random = new Random();
108                
109                
110                List<SkillSpecAPI> leftovers = new ArrayList<SkillSpecAPI>();
111                List<List<SkillSpecAPI>> unknownTiers = new ArrayList<List<SkillSpecAPI>>();
112                
113                MutableCharacterStatsAPI stats = person.getStats();
114                int level = stats.getLevel();
115                
116                for (String ap : SkillData.getAptitudes().keySet()) {
117                        SkillsForAptitude skills = SkillData.getSkills(ap);
118                        int tier = 0;
119                        for (List<SkillSpecAPI> list : skills.tiers) {
120                                tier++;
121                                
122                                List<SkillSpecAPI> unknown = new ArrayList<SkillSpecAPI>();
123                                for (SkillSpecAPI skill : list) {
124                                        if (!skill.isCombatOfficerSkill()) continue;
125                                        if (skill.hasTag(Skills.TAG_DEPRECATED)) continue;
126                                        if (skill.hasTag(Skills.TAG_PLAYER_ONLY)) continue;
127                                        if (stats.getSkillLevel(skill.getId()) <= 0) {
128                                                unknown.add(skill);
129                                        }
130                                }
131                                if (list.size() == unknown.size() && (tier < 4 || level >= 3)) {
132                                        unknownTiers.add(list);
133                                } else {
134                                        leftovers.addAll(unknown);
135                                }
136                        }
137                }
138                
139                int max = OFFICER_SKILL_CHOICES_BASE;
140                if (Misc.isMentored(person)) {
141                        max = OFFICER_SKILL_CHOICES_MENTORED;
142                }
143                List<String> result = new ArrayList<String>();
144                
145                if (!unknownTiers.isEmpty()) {
146                        WeightedRandomPicker<List<SkillSpecAPI>> picker = new WeightedRandomPicker<List<SkillSpecAPI>>(random);
147                        picker.addAll(unknownTiers);
148                        while (!picker.isEmpty() && result.size() < max) {
149                                List<SkillSpecAPI> pick = picker.pickAndRemove();
150                                for (SkillSpecAPI s : pick) {
151                                        if (result.size() >= max) break; 
152                                        result.add(s.getId());
153                                }
154                        }
155                }
156                
157                if (!leftovers.isEmpty()) {
158                        WeightedRandomPicker<SkillSpecAPI> picker = new WeightedRandomPicker<SkillSpecAPI>(random);
159                        picker.addAll(leftovers);
160                        while (!picker.isEmpty() && result.size() < max) {
161                                SkillSpecAPI pick = picker.pickAndRemove();
162                                result.add(pick.getId());
163                        }
164                }
165                
166                return result;
167        }

170        public List<String> pickLevelupSkillsV3(PersonAPI person, Random random) {
171                if (random == null) random = new Random();
172                
173                
174                List<SkillSpecAPI> top = new ArrayList<SkillSpecAPI>();
175                List<SkillSpecAPI> leftovers = new ArrayList<SkillSpecAPI>();
176                
177                MutableCharacterStatsAPI stats = person.getStats();
178                int level = stats.getLevel();
179                
180                for (String ap : SkillData.getAptitudes().keySet()) {
181                        SkillsForAptitude skills = SkillData.getSkills(ap);
182                        for (List<SkillSpecAPI> list : skills.tiers) {
183                                boolean topTier = false;
184                                for (SkillSpecAPI skill : list) {
185                                        if (!skill.isCombatOfficerSkill()) continue;
186                                        if (skill.hasTag(Skills.TAG_DEPRECATED)) continue;
187                                        if (skill.hasTag(Skills.TAG_PLAYER_ONLY)) continue;
188                                        if (stats.getSkillLevel(skill.getId()) <= 0) {
189                                                if (skill.getTier() == 5) topTier = true;
190                                                if (!topTier || level >= 3) {
191                                                        if (topTier) {
192                                                                top.add(skill);
193                                                        } else {
194                                                                leftovers.add(skill);
195                                                        }
196                                                }
197                                        }
198                                }
199                        }
200                }
201                
202                int max = OFFICER_SKILL_CHOICES_BASE;
203                if (Misc.isMentored(person)) {
204                        max = OFFICER_SKILL_CHOICES_MENTORED;
205                }
206                if (person.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().contains(MemFlags.OFFICER_SKILL_PICKS_PER_LEVEL)) {
207                        max = person.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().getInt(MemFlags.OFFICER_SKILL_PICKS_PER_LEVEL);
208                }
209                List<String> result = new ArrayList<String>();
210                
211                if (!top.isEmpty()) {
212                        WeightedRandomPicker<SkillSpecAPI> picker = new WeightedRandomPicker<SkillSpecAPI>(random);
213                        picker.addAll(top);
214                        while (!picker.isEmpty() && result.size() < max) {
215                                SkillSpecAPI pick = picker.pickAndRemove();
216                                result.add(pick.getId());
217                        }
218                }
219                if (!leftovers.isEmpty()) {
220                        WeightedRandomPicker<SkillSpecAPI> picker = new WeightedRandomPicker<SkillSpecAPI>(random);
221                        picker.addAll(leftovers);
222                        while (!picker.isEmpty() && result.size() < max) {
223                                SkillSpecAPI pick = picker.pickAndRemove();
224                                result.add(pick.getId());
225                        }
226                }
227                
228                return result;
229        }

231        
232        public List<String> pickLevelupSkills(PersonAPI person, Random random) {
233                if (true) return pickLevelupSkillsV3(person, random);
234                if (random == null) random = new Random();
235                
236                boolean hasCarrierSkills = false;
237                for (SkillLevelAPI skill : person.getStats().getSkillsCopy()) {
238                        if (!skill.getSkill().isCombatOfficerSkill()) continue;
239                        
240                        if (skill.getSkill().hasTag(Skills.TAG_CARRIER)) {
241                                hasCarrierSkills = true;
242                                break;
243                        }
244                }
245                
246                WeightedRandomPicker<String> nonMaxedSkills = new WeightedRandomPicker<String>(random);
247                WeightedRandomPicker<String> knownSkills = new WeightedRandomPicker<String>(random);
248                WeightedRandomPicker<String> carrierSkills = new WeightedRandomPicker<String>(random);
249                WeightedRandomPicker<String> knownCarrierSkills = new WeightedRandomPicker<String>(random);
250                WeightedRandomPicker<String> nonCarrierSkills = new WeightedRandomPicker<String>(random);
251                WeightedRandomPicker<String> knownNonCarrierSkills = new WeightedRandomPicker<String>(random);
252                List<String> allSkillIds = Global.getSettings().getSortedSkillIds();
253                int knownSkillCount = 0;
254                for (String skillId : allSkillIds) {
255                        SkillSpecAPI skill = Global.getSettings().getSkillSpec(skillId);
256                        if (skill.isCombatOfficerSkill()) {
257                                addSkill(person, nonMaxedSkills, skillId);
258                                float level = person.getStats().getSkillLevel(skillId);
259                                if (level > 0) {
260                                        knownSkillCount++;
261                                        addSkill(person, knownSkills, skillId);
262                                }
263                                if (skill.hasTag(Skills.TAG_CARRIER)) {
264                                        addSkill(person, carrierSkills, skillId);
265                                        if (level > 0) addSkill(person, knownCarrierSkills, skillId);
266                                } else {
267                                        addSkill(person, nonCarrierSkills, skillId);
268                                        if (level > 0) addSkill(person, knownNonCarrierSkills, skillId);
269                                }
270                        }
271                }
272                List<String> result = new ArrayList<String>();
273
274                if (!knownSkills.isEmpty()) {
275                        String pick = knownSkills.pickAndRemove();
276                        nonMaxedSkills.remove(pick);
277                        carrierSkills.remove(pick);
278                        nonCarrierSkills.remove(pick);
279                        knownCarrierSkills.remove(pick);
280                        knownNonCarrierSkills.remove(pick);
281                        result.add(pick);
282                }
283                
284                int maxSkillsPerOfficer = 10;
285                if (knownSkillCount >= maxSkillsPerOfficer) {
286                        if (hasCarrierSkills && !knownCarrierSkills.isEmpty()) {
287                                String pick = knownCarrierSkills.pickAndRemove();
288                                result.add(pick);
289                        } else if (!knownNonCarrierSkills.isEmpty() && result.size() == 0) {
290                                String pick = knownNonCarrierSkills.pickAndRemove();
291                                result.add(pick);
292                        } else if (!knownSkills.isEmpty()) {
293                                String pick = knownSkills.pickAndRemove();
294                                result.add(pick);
295                        }
296                } else {
297                        if (hasCarrierSkills && !carrierSkills.isEmpty()) {
298                                String pick = carrierSkills.pickAndRemove();
299                                result.add(pick);
300                        } else if (!nonCarrierSkills.isEmpty() && result.size() == 0) {
301                                String pick = nonCarrierSkills.pickAndRemove();
302                                result.add(pick);
303                        } else if (!nonMaxedSkills.isEmpty()) {
304                                String pick = nonMaxedSkills.pickAndRemove();
305                                result.add(pick);
306                        }
307                }
308                
309                if (result.size() < 2 && knownSkillCount < maxSkillsPerOfficer) {
310                        for (String id : result) {
311                                nonMaxedSkills.remove(id);
312                        }
313                        if (!nonMaxedSkills.isEmpty()) {
314                                String pick = nonMaxedSkills.pickAndRemove();
315                                knownSkills.remove(pick);
316                                result.add(pick);
317                        }
318                }
319                
320                return result;
321        }
322        
323        
324        
325        private void addSkill(PersonAPI person, WeightedRandomPicker<String> picker, String skill) {
326                if (person.getStats().getSkillLevel(skill) >= 3) return;
327                picker.add(skill);
328        }
